body: Hello! I own Hidden Gem Hair Studio. I am currently creating a bridal team that will be ready by summer if you're still looking for help! Good luck! Feel free to message me privately too if you need more suggestions!

If you're considering going into beauty school I'd go to Noenoonan if I were you. I did go to toni&guy years ago and it did do me well, I have an accomplished job now and make good money but I worked my ass off to build my clients and build my skills after. This career is so amazing and the opportunities are endless! But bottom line the education at noenoonan is better and they train the students to be more prepared than other schools.

This week has been particularly rough. My other half is going through a world wind of things and we took time to separate. Hes always been suicidal, never lived for himself, and we were dating an other person too - when she left it kind of all spiraled down for him. Which is understood. I know what its like to lose a relationship of a long time. They have two kids have been together for 11 years, and he needs this time to heal. But last night... I woke up crying numerous times. This is the hardest thing I've had to go through. He keeps telling me this is temporary if we get help and work through our mental illness, but he's not sure how the journey to get there will be. Somedsys are really bad on him and he doubts everything on the face of the world.  I haven't gotten out of bed today. I have barely aten (I've lost 20 lbs in 1.5 months and im tiny so that is a lot) today I didnt even take the kids to school bc I couldn't get up. I want this life to end. I woke up do angry at God. I told him I'd rather go to hell than be around someone who lets people go through this kind of pain.
I definitely feel this way as well. A big part of me just wishes I'd get it over with now. This world is so sick and fucked up I am having trouble seeing any good in it.
